Name: HTTPS Guard Security Event Registry
Description: This registry defines security and anomaly events detected at the kernel layer via eBPF.

HttpsTlsVersionViolation.Description: An incoming or outgoing HTTPS connection attempted to use a banned TLS version.
HttpsTlsVersionViolation.Resolution: Upgrade the client application to support TLS 1.2 or TLS 1.3.

HttpsPayloadAnomalyDetected.Description: An HTTP/HTTPS request contained strings indicative of a web attack payload.
HttpsPayloadAnomalyDetected.Resolution: Inspect process behavior, validate source endpoint, and review server access logs.

HttpsCertificateAccessViolation.Description: An unrecognized process attempted to access the BMC's HTTPS certificate or private key file.
HttpsCertificateAccessViolation.Resolution: Verify the accessing process is authorized; investigate for key theft or process impersonation.

HttpsWeakCipherSuiteDetected.Description: An incoming HTTPS connection offered a cryptographically weak cipher suite.
HttpsWeakCipherSuiteDetected.Resolution: Review client TLS configuration; disable support for weak cipher suites if this traffic is expected to continue.

HttpsSniAnomalyDetected.Description: An incoming HTTPS connection's TLS Server Name Indication did not match the expected hostname.
HttpsSniAnomalyDetected.Resolution: Verify the client is targeting the correct BMC hostname; investigate for domain fronting or misdirected traffic.

HttpsConnectionRateViolation.Description: A source exceeded the configured connection-rate threshold, indicating possible SYN flood, port scan, or volumetric abuse.
HttpsConnectionRateViolation.Resolution: Investigate the source IP; the connection has been blocklisted if enforcement is enabled.

HttpsSlowlorisDetected.Description: A source held an unusually high number of slow, incomplete HTTPS connections open, indicative of a Slowloris-style resource-exhaustion attempt.
HttpsSlowlorisDetected.Resolution: Investigate the source IP; consider tightening connection-timeout settings.

HttpsTlsRenegotiationStorm.Description: A source initiated an unusually high number of TLS handshakes within a short window, indicative of a renegotiation-based denial-of-service attempt.
HttpsTlsRenegotiationStorm.Resolution: Investigate the source IP; the connection has been blocklisted if enforcement is enabled.
